transport.function: kimi_send(read_secret, url=KIMI_URL, opener=urllib.request.urlopen) returns send(payload, timeout_seconds): one HTTPS JSON POST per call to the Moonshot chat-completions URL, Bearer key held in memory after one read, returns the decoded JSON; it does not loop on tool_calls and does not add request fields itself
transport.failure_mapping: HTTP error -> KIMI_HTTP with status; timeout -> TimeoutError; connection error -> KIMI_CONNECTION_RESET; body over 1 MiB -> KIMI_RESPONSE_LIMIT; undecodable -> KIMI_MALFORMED (kimi_port.py:39-53)
transport.telemetry: journal_telemetry prints closed fields only (kind, attempt, state, outcome, elapsed_seconds, prompt_chars, max_tokens, timeout_seconds) and the total token count; never the prompt, the answer or a key (kimi_port.py:57-62)
